projects.title: Analytics Dashboard – Shopping Cart
projects.description: Interactive real-time analytics dashboard for shopping behavior: trend visualization, cart tracking, consumer statistics and dynamic charts. Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB database and TypeScript typing.

projects.title: GI-FSTE App – Engineering Cycle Management
projects.description: Web platform for academic and administrative management of the Computer Engineering program: students, teachers, courses, grades, absences and schedules. Three distinct spaces: Student, Teacher and Administrator.

projects.title: Driving School Web App
projects.description: Full driving school management system: candidates, instructors, vehicles, session scheduling, online payments and exam tracking. Three distinct roles: Administrator, Instructor and Candidate.
